title: The man with a measuring line (third night vision)

symbols.in_text_interpretation: Jerusalem will be inhabited as unwalled villages because of its multitude (2:4).
The LORD himself will be the wall of fire around it and the glory within it (2:5).

description: A man goes to measure Jerusalem's width and length; an angel tells him that Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls because of its multitude, the LORD being a wall of fire around it and the glory within.
